column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the pathsforward warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Model: A Malformed Document Is Refused, a Malformed Symbol Never Crashes
The Tag Grammar: A Declared Grain, a Write Suffix, and Only Artifact Writes Lease
The Vector Grammar: Its Own Prefix, Every Metric in Order, and No Score Kept Here
Redaction: A Literal Leaves One Waypoint by Hash, and a Scan Confirms It Is Gone
The Hash: One Tagged Form Emitted, Four Legacy Forms Accepted as a Transition
The Check: Every Property Fires on Its Defect, and a Clean State Fires None
The Payload: Budgeted With the Marker Counted, Refused When Nothing Fits
The Mutations: Typed, All or Nothing, and Honest About the Block Count
The Tick Lock: A Pure Decision, and One Holder Among Racing Processes
The Leases: Artifact Writes Only, All or Nothing, Renewed by the Tick, a Lapse Listed
The Store: Atomic Replace, a Flock That Excludes, and No Torn Read
The Ledger: Structured Columns, and a Refusal of Anything That Shifts Them
The Atomize Signal: A Top Waypoint Already Advanced Is Flagged to Split
The Overlap Report: One Line per Tag That Two Live Waypoints Declare
The Mirror: Derived, Said So, and in Rank Order
The Selftest: The Installed Tool Witnesses Itself
The CLI: No Default Root, the Bare Call Reads, and Every Exit Code
The Time Reader: An RFC 5545 Date or Instant, Never a Floating Time
The Recurrence Grammar: An RFC 5545 RRULE a Reader Can Expand, Checked Without Expanding It
The iCalendar Writer: Escaped, Folded at 75 Octets, and Ended in CRLF
The Calendar Projection: One VTODO per Waypoint, Read-Only, Residue Omitted
The Time Zones: One VTIMEZONE per TZID Used, Its Transitions Found to the Second
The Mint Line: --add Ledgers minted for the New Symbol, and Nothing Is Half-Written
The Ledger Line Break: Every Character the Reader Splits On Is Refused in a Note, Derived From Python and Not Listed
The Unlinked Count: n of m Live Waypoints Linked, an Edge Counted From Either End, and Nothing Rewritten
The Declared Outcome Sets: A Queue May Close Its Tick Vocabulary, and Absent Means Unchanged
The Foreign Blocker: A Peer Queue Is Read, Never Written, and Every Blocker That Stays Is Named
The Blocker Watch: A Tick Says Which Blockers Changed State Since the Last One, Local and Foreign, Before It Prunes
The Home Path: An Evidence String Holding a Path Under the Host's Home Directories Is Refused on Write and Names the Redact Flag, and a Bare Prefix or a Relative Citation Is Not
The Working-Card Verdict: Each Working Card Is GATING, LANDED or STALE From the Gate, the Landed Commits Naming It and Its Blockers, With the Status to Propose, and Nothing Is Written
The Pruned Edge: A Prune Names Every Blocker Edge It Removes With the Card It Was On, Prints It and Ledgers It, and a Ledger That Cannot Be Written Never Fails the Prune

The Status Transition: Every Status a Card Changes Is Ledgered at the Writer's One Save Point as a status Line, a Minted or Dropped Card Is Not a Transition, and a Ledger That Cannot Be Written Never Fails the Edit
The Landed Blocker: A New Blocker Naming a Done or Dropped Card, Local or Foreign, Is Refused on Write, and One the Card Already Holds Is Left to the Prune
The Tick Roll: A Cycle Boundary Always Allowed, the Lock Kept for Its Holder, and the Count of Cards It Advanced Written Into Its Line
The Atomize Verb: Children Minted Under a Parent That Becomes a Blocked Umbrella, a Human Hold Left to the Operator, and Nothing Written on a Refusal
The Declared Advance Set: Atomize Counts What a Queue Names, and the Deny-List Otherwise
The Inbound Census: Peer Cards Waiting on This Repo, Claimed or Not, Read Without Writing and Never Dropped in Silence
The Realizability Fields: Optional, Checked for Form Only, a Deferral Recorded and a Waiver Never Stored
The Certify Reader: Each Waypoint's Coordinate and Residue From the Pinned opa, Read Only, and Not Checked Never Reads as Clean
The Admitted Transition: Saved, Then Judged, Then Marked; Minting Is Never Refused and Only a Bare Drop Is
Residue Attracts Work: One Claimable Card per Waypoint and Gate, a Rerun Finds It, and Nothing Is Minted Unjudged
The Skipped Symbol: A Number the Counter Issued and Nothing Stored Is Recorded in Residue With a Reason, and Nothing Else Is
The Delivered Version: 0.0.n From the Highest Completed Waypoint, Derived From the Queue and Never Typed
The Standing List Has a Writer: --standing-set Replaces It Whole, an Empty File Is Refused, and the Payload Carries What Was Stored
The Bundled Title: A Title Over 150 Characters That Also Carries a Clause Mark Is Refused at Mint and at Retitle, and Anything Else Passes
The Gate Card: A Red Commit Gate Is One Card That the Whole Open Ledger Waits On, Its Repair Is Not Blocked by It, and Green Lifts Only What Waited on It
The Gate Card From the Command Line: --gate-red Names the Card, Its Repairs and the Operator Ask, --gate-green Lifts What Waited on It, and a Flag the Mode Does Not Read Is Refused
The Nested Citation: A Workstream Is Cited by Its Path, Each Segment Shaped Like a Repo Name, so Nothing Empty, Dot-Led or Linked Is Read

Manifest: A Card Names Exact Repo-Relative Files and a Size Class, and a Directory, Glob, Absolute Path, Parent Step, Link or Duplicate Is Refused
Tick Hooks: A Repo's Stored Commands Run After --tick-open's Steps, and No Hook Can Break the Tick
Manifests From File: Many Cards' Manifests Are Stored From One JSON File, All or Nothing, With a Dry Run by Default
Close Against Rank: A Tick Close Is Refused When It Skipped the Top Ranked Ready Card Without Naming It
Generated Files: A File the Repo Lists as Generated Is Not an Exclusive Write and Leaves the Lease, a Real File Still Conflicts
Writer Heartbeat: Every Writer Call Leaves the Record the Watchdog Reads, and a Fault or a Torn File Never Fails the Call
Idle Queue Check: Only Ready Cards Without a Witness Count as Work a Session Could Start
Watchdog Command: --tick-open Prints the Line a Session Runs in the Background, Found on PATH or in the Checkout, and Says So When None Exists
Bulk Status: One Reviewed Call Blocks or Releases a Set of Cards All or Nothing, and Done and Working Stay Per Card
Loop Prompt Watch: --tick-open Says What Changed in the Canonical Loop Prompt Since the Last Tick, Once, and Says Nothing When There Is None
A Waiting Card Names Other Acceptable Suppliers, as a Fallback and Never a Second Block
A Card Is Advanced Only When a Landed Commit Carries It, and an Edit Alone Is Shown Apart
The Watchdog Start Line Reaches a Session Whose Tick Stays Open
The Update-Many Help: Every Selector the Writer Accepts Is Named in Its Help, So No Session Builds the List by Hand
A Ledger Line Carries the Writing Session's Transcript UUID When the Environment Names One

The Waypoint Location: An Optional One-Line Place Is Set With --update --location, Stored as Written, Cleared by the Empty String, Refused Over More Than One Line, Not Bulk, and Projected as an iCalendar LOCATION
Mutation Events: One Event per Changed Field with Starting Values, Long Text as a Length and a Hash
Mutation Event Emit: One Log Line per Event and One Sample per Field, Labelled Repo, Field and Via, Never Failing the Write
Mutation Shipping: Every Saved Edit Sends Its Events From the Single Save Point With the Writer's Own Context and Never Fails the Edit
The Landed Status: Open and Not Workable, Ranked With Blocked, Accepted by the Check, and a Landed Card With No Witness Is a Finding
The Status Readers and Landed: Open for Triage as a Blocker and as a Duplicate Candidate, Done Being the Closed Control
The Landed Task: In Process and Never Completed in the Calendar Projection, Done Being the Completed Control
The Landing Stamp: landed_at Written Once When a Card Enters Landed, Kept Through Done, Cleared on Reopening, and Never Written for a Card That Never Landed
The Deploys Field: Set by a Flag, Absent on a Card Never Given It, a Landed Card Must Declare It True, and a Deploying Done Card Needs Its Witness and Language
The Withheld Flag: A Card Is Kept Out of the Repo's Export Whole or Not At All, a Card Never Given the Flag Is Published and Grows No Key
